description: Defines the class Kint_Objects_SplFileInfo which extends KintObject and parses PHP's SplFileInfo objects to extract metadata such as filename, permissions, size, type, and real path.

classes.name: Kint_Objects_SplFileInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates and parses information from SplFileInfo objects.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the given variable if it is an instance of SplFileInfo, extracting file metadata such as name, permissions, and path.
